main_text.l: Olim circa A. C. 1300 Zeilonu-ni regi subjecta erat: postea Zingalæ (ita appellantur Zeilonenses) trucidato rege suo Insulam in multa diviserunt regna, donec A. C. 1580 quidam tonsor, cui nomen Maru Raju, totius Insulæ Monarcham se constitueret, sede regiâ in urbe Candy posita.
Minorum Insularum regna omnia enumerari nequeunt.

page.notes: The digit in "1300" is printed in old form (ʒ-like); read as 1300. "Zeilonu-ni" is hyphenated at the line end. Faint show-through of the reverse page is visible on the right and is not transcribed. The catchword "au-" is at the bottom right and the signature "F" at the bottom left of the text block.
